result.summary: The page is generally well laid out and visually polished. One likely content duplication stands out in the restaurant carousel.

issues.description: The first two cards in the “Fastest near you” section appear to be exact duplicates, both showing Green Bowl Poké with the same image, delivery time, and delivery fee.
issues.suggestion: Verify the restaurant data and remove the duplicate entry or display a distinct location, dish, or restaurant if both listings are intentional.
